'''2010 World Championship''' was a Players Committee constructed World Championship, 12–15 August 2010, in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, using the pre-reset virtual pool ([[Legacy Open]]).<ref name="forum">https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewforum.php?f=559</ref><ref name="decklists">https://www.starwarsccg.org/2010-decklists/</ref><ref name="standings">https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=75427. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261012152200/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t75427.html Internet Archive]</ref> Published lists on the Players Committee 2010 decklists desk are the Day 2 and Day 3 PDFs only (no Day 1 or Team Tournament PDF was published). [[Dan Kim]] defeated [[Kyle Krueger]] in the final.

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Site:''' Philadelphia, Pennsylvania
* '''Dates:''' 12–15 August 2010
* '''Winner:''' [[Dan Kim]]

=== Top 8 bracket ===

A 2020 forum post quoting an earlier player compilation gives this Day 3 bracket (seeds in brackets).<ref name="f75427-1300387">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1300387#p1300387 Post by Yoshi], "SWCCG Worlds Day 3 Standings History", forum.starwarsccg.org (28 May 2020). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261012152200/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t75427.html#p1300387 Internet Archive]</ref> It does not name [[Chris Twiss]], whose Light list is in the Day 3 PDF.

* Quarterfinals: (1) [[Jonny Chu]] def. (8) [[Aaron Kingery]]; (2) [[Kyle Krueger]] def. (7) [[Matt Sokol]]; (3) [[Steve Baroni]] def. (6) [[Chris Terwilliger]]; (5) [[Dan Kim]] def. (4) [[Justin Desai]]
* Semifinals: Dan Kim def. Jonny Chu; Kyle Krueger def. Steve Baroni
* Final: Dan Kim def. Kyle Krueger

Day 3 Xerox sheets are in [[:File:2010 Worlds Day 3.pdf]] (pages 11–12 are [[Kyle Krueger]]'s typed Dark and Light lists). [[Chris Twiss]] Light and [[Chris Terwilliger]] Dark are one-side-only in that PDF. Steve Baroni Dark ([[2010 Worlds Day 3 Steve Baroni DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V)]], deck name Dry Clean Only) is published; unreadable lines are marked (illegible) on the deck page.

== Day 2 ==
